name: SQLite Vacuum
description: Compresses the SQLite database file manually or via cron (3h default).
project_description:
When using a SQLite database, the database file can get fragmented and grow far beyond the actual data size. This module checks if the currend database is SQLite and then VACUUM s it every 3 hours.
